name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Persist encrypted SSH deployment profiles and publish local projects through confirmation-gated SSH deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Save SSH targets with a form and publish local projects.
interface.longDescription: Opens a native structured form for named SSH deployment profiles, saves them in the current user's OS credential protection, then packages and uploads the current project with OpenSSH and runs an explicit command only after a hashed dry run and confirmation. Private key contents are never accepted or read.
defaultPrompt: Open the form to save a secure SSH deployment profile.
Deploy this local site using my saved production profile.
List my saved SSH deployment profiles.
